summary: Update the certificates and TLS settings
description: Fields set by environment variables are ignored. The change is applied before it is saved: when applying fails, nothing is saved.

key_type.description: Key type of new certificates (env ACME_KEY_TYPE)

key_size.description: Curve (ecdsa) or key size (rsa) of new certificates (env ACME_KEY_SIZE)

profile.description: ACME profile of new certificates, empty = none; must be offered by the ACME server (env ACME_PROFILE)

must_staple.description: Request certificates with the OCSP must-staple extension, forces OCSP stapling on (env ACME_MUST_STAPLE)

server_tls_verify.description: Verify the TLS certificate of the ACME server (env ACME_SERVER_TLS_VERIFY)

renewal_interval.description: Hours between certificate renewal runs (env CERTBOT_RUN_INTERVAL)

ocsp_stapling.description: OCSP stapling for ACME certificates (env ACME_OCSP_STAPLING)

custom_ocsp_stapling.description: OCSP stapling for custom certificates (env CUSTOM_OCSP_STAPLING)

default_certificate_id.description: Certificate of the default host, 0 = built-in (env DEFAULT_CERT_ID)

ech_rotation_interval.description: Hours between ECH key rotations (env ECH_ROTATION_INTERVAL)
